_comment: CHIKIT — APP CONFIG
One file, everything: the Node backend and the React frontend both read
this exact file (see backend-node/src/lib/config.js and vite.config.js).
HOW ENVIRONMENTS WORK:
Change "environment" below to "development" or "production".
Each of those two blocks below holds a COMPLETE, independent set of
credentials/settings for that environment — nothing is merged or
inherited between them, so what you see in a block is exactly what
gets used. To go live, switch "environment" to "production" and make
sure the "production" block's values are filled in for real.
Every value is a plain string (even true/false and numbers) — copy the
same style when editing so nothing needs converting.
All third-party credentials below are PLACEHOLDERS (empty strings). This
is a fresh project — fill in your own Razorpay/Brevo/MSG91/Google keys
before enabling those features. Do not reuse another project's live keys.
After changing a value:
• Backend (Node) only reads this file on startup — restart
`npm run dev` (or `dev:server`) after editing any value below.
• Frontend (Vite) only reads this file when it starts too — same
restart covers both.
See each key's own name — they match exactly what they configure, e.g.
DB_HOST/DB_PORT/DB_NAME/DB_USER/DB_PASS is the MySQL connection.
